name: Hamamatsu (Japan)

colors.symbolism: Lake Hamana and the Pacific coast

description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hamamatsu city emblem: a green disc cut by a blue-and-white curling wave.
history: Adopted around the 2005 twelve-municipality merger that created the enlarged Hamamatsu, a government-designated city from 2007.

features.role: Hamamatsu city emblem — a green disc crossed by a blue wave
features.symbolism: nature and water — the Enshū coast and Lake Hamana
